labels.no_price: no quote in the bulk market file
labels.penny: share price under the delisting-risk floor
labels.cap_implausible: market cap and total assets differ by orders of magnitude
labels.units_unverified: EPS x shares does not reconstruct net income
labels.pe_suspect: earnings multiple below the plausible floor
labels.short_history: fewer than four annual EPS periods
labels.trough_base: base year is a trough — recovery, not growth
labels.step_change: latest year has no history behind it — a step, not a rate
labels.loss_window: a loss year inside the growth window — a turnaround, not a rate
labels.spike_year: one year does all the growing — the trend without it does not qualify
labels.debt_unknown: debt not filed and the liability total could not settle it
labels.stale_balance_sheet: the debt tags stopped years before the company did
labels.capex_unknown: capex or operating cash flow not filed
labels.facts_unavailable: SEC did not return filings — a network fact, not a company one
